name: BloodLink
tagline: Find the right blood donor in minutes, not hours
problem: Families forward WhatsApp pleas to everyone and wait for hours
Nobody knows who is eligible: recent donors reply and travel for nothing
Scarce groups (O-, Rh-negative) get used when a common group would do
One bank's units expire while a bank 40 km away is short
solution: Rank only eligible, compatible donors with a transparent score
Alert in small waves; stand donors down once units are drawn
Balance stock across blood banks before units expire
Donor app: self-check, next eligible date, badges

features.title: Correct compatibility
features.desc: ABO/Rh red-cell + plasma rules from antigens, all 64 pairs tested

features.title: Safety gates
features.desc: 90/120-day interval, age, weight, deferral - reason and next date shown

features.title: Explainable ranking
features.desc: Compatibility + travel time + response + fairness, every point shown

features.title: Live wave timeline
features.desc: Simulated alerts vs broadcast-all and phone list on the same dice

features.title: Bank network
features.desc: FEFO, moving-average forecast, expiry risk, greedy transfers

features.title: Offline map
features.desc: SVG map of donors, hospitals and banks - no tiles, no internet

architecture: Browser UI -> vanilla JS tabs, SVG maps and charts
app.py -> stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer, JSON API, validation
ranking.py -> gates + weighted, explained donor score
simulation.py -> event-driven wave vs baseline simulator
inventory.py -> FEFO, forecast, transfers, month simulation
dataset.py -> seeded synthetic donors and 5-bank network
algorithms: Antigen-subset ABO/Rh rule – red-cell and plasma compatibility
Haversine + circuity factor – distance and travel time
Weighted score with Beta(2,2) prior – explainable ranking
Discrete-event simulation – wave broadcast vs baselines
FEFO + moving average – issue order and demand forecast
innovation: Every rank, exclusion and transfer is explained
Fairness term spreads load across donors
One engine for donors and blood bank stock

results.label: median time to fulfil vs broadcast (sim, 300 requests)
expired units per month with transfers (sim, 20 months)

demo_flow: Run demo: 3 units A+ critical at Tiruchengode
Show safety gates and excluded donors with reasons
Open donor #1 score breakdown and the map
Play the live wave timeline vs baselines
Send wave plan: fairness and interval update
Bank network: apply transfers, month result
Donor app self-check and compatibility matrix
impact: Families get donors faster: 88% within 2 h in simulation
No wasted trips by ineligible donors
Fewer expired units and fewer local shortages
Donors are not spammed - load is shared
business: SaaS for private hospital and blood bank networks
CSR / public-health funding for government banks
District pilot with college donor registries
future: Learn weights from real accept/decline outcomes
Seasonal demand forecast and camp planning
SMS/IVR alerts in Tamil and English
